_comment: Function/tool schemas for Angel. Paste these into Retell's 'Custom Functions' (or 'Tools') section on the agent. Each function's webhook_url should point at your n8n webhook (see n8n/angel-workflow.json). Field names follow OpenAI-style function calling, which Retell and most voice platforms accept directly.

functions.name: book_appointment
functions.description: Book a 30-minute demo call between the caller and Saif. Call this only after the caller has agreed to a specific day/time and provided their contact details.

vertical.description: Which target vertical the caller's business falls into

phone_number.description: Caller's phone number in E.164 format where possible

email.description: Caller's email address for the calendar invite and confirmation

preferred_datetime.description: ISO 8601 datetime the caller agreed to for the 30-minute demo call, in Europe/London time

notes.description: Brief context for Saif: pain point mentioned, call volume, anything relevant ahead of the call

functions.name: send_confirmation_email
functions.description: Send a branded confirmation email to the caller after a demo call has been successfully booked.

appointment_datetime.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the confirmed demo call, in Europe/London time

functions.name: take_message
functions.description: Log a message and notify Saif by email when the caller does not book a demo on the call, or has an urgent issue that needs human follow-up.

caller_name.description: Full name of the caller, if given

business_name.description: Name of the caller's business, if given

summary.description: Brief summary of the conversation and what the caller wanted

urgency.description: How urgently Saif should follow up
